selectionDelta: Only main changes. It selects P2bTarget.fixtures.filter fun fixture => !fixture.joined and calls the unchanged P2bTarget.emit.
removedMain:
def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [output] := args | throw (IO.userError "expected one output path")
  match P2bTarget.manifest with
  | .error why => throw (IO.userError why)
  | .ok value => IO.FS.writeFile output (value.pretty 100 ++ "\n")
replacementMain:
def main (args : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [output] := args | throw (IO.userError "expected one output path")
  let baseline : Except String Lean.Json := do
    let selected := P2bTarget.fixtures.filter fun fixture => !fixture.joined
    return Lean.Json.mkObj [
      ("format", Lean.toJson "effect4-p2b-single-baseline-v1"),
      ("evidence", Lean.toJson "actual Program.printTyped; unchanged single-member companions; type-only"),
      ("fixtures", Lean.Json.arr (← selected.mapM P2bTarget.emit).toArray)]
  match baseline with
  | .error why => throw (IO.userError why)
  | .ok value => IO.FS.writeFile output (value.pretty 100 ++ "\n")
